text:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT ALERT — ap-southeast3: GPU quota exhausted, autoscaler pending. Queue growth 4.2x over last 12m. Throttling observed on /v1/generate and /v1/chat endpoints. Pager triggered.

oncall-ryan: I’m on it. Looking at autoscaler logs and quota API now.

svc-autoscaler: Autoscaler reports pending scale-up: requested 48 GPUs, quota limit = 32. New node requests are ERROR: QuotaExceeded.

eng-runtime-lead: Can we immediately divert non-prod/low-priority inference to hosted fallback model in us-east1? That’d reduce pressure.

platform-sre-anya: We have a partial fallback policy but it needs route update. I can flip the route for low-priority traffic. @support-jamie can you mark affected customers?

support-jamie: Yep, pulling list of customers with requests hitting ap-southeast3 in last hour. ETA 4m.

infra-oncall-kim: I’m opening a GCP quota request now but that takes hours. We should apply short-term mitigations.

incident-bot: Runbook step 1: confirm quota. Runbook step 2: apply routing fallback. Runbook step 3: start quota request.

oncall-ryan: Confirming quota via gcloud:
```bash
gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast3 --project=redwood-prod --format=json | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS")'
```
Response shows limit 32, usage 32.

svc-autoscaler: Logs show repeated NodePool create attempts failing with: \"QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project\". Autoscaler state = pending. Queue length per model: embed-service = 120 (norm 20), chat-service = 420 (norm 100).

eng-runtime-lead: Ok. Apply these mitigations in parallel: 1) route low-priority to us-east1 hosted, 2) reduce max batch size and concurrency on ap-southeast3 to free up slots, 3) enable degraded model (smaller variant) for burst traffic.

platform-sre-anya: Doing 1) and 2) now. Patch snippet to update route:
```yaml
- match: route.label == \"priority:low\"
  to: region:us-east1, model:pg-small, fallback:true
```
Applying now.

platform-sre-anya: Route changes pushed. Low-priority traffic drop observed ~90% within 20s. Queue decreased slightly.

svc-autoscaler: Reducing batch_size from 64 -> 32 and concurrency limit -2 on the 8 active pods. That should free memory and GPU slots for queued requests.

support-jamie: Customer impact: 12 paid customers have tail latency > 10s; 3 customers see failed requests (429). I'm posting an advisory to the status page and emailing the 3 affected enterprise customers.

sales-eli: Please flag any high-importance customers, I’ll join comms for enterprise outreach.

customer-ops: One enterprise (acme-ai) on Dedicated reported degraded throughput. They’re already on a Dedicated pool but routed through ap-southeast3; we should offer cross-region failover.

infra-oncall-kim: Quota request submitted: GCP console ticket 12345678. Marked as high-priority with justification (production outage). Estimated response 3–6h.

eng-runtime-lead: Short-term: enable cross-region soft-failover for canary and enterprise traffic to eu-west1 with model-compatibility check. Platform: can you spin up compatibility shim?

platform-sre-anya: Spinning up shim instance to proxy requests to eu-west1. Will patch routing to prefer local but fallback to eu-west1 on pending queue > 20.

incident-bot: Note: enabling cross-region increases egress cost and adds latency — accepted as mitigation.

oncall-ryan: Manual change: route enterprise-acme -> eu-west1 for their production traffic. Confirmed reduced queue for their requests.

svc-autoscaler: After batch/concurrency changes and routing, overall queue reduced by ~35% in 12 minutes. Autoscaler attempted new creates again but still blocked by quota for additional GPUs; current active GPUs = 32.

support-jamie: Status page update posted: \"Doing live mitigation for GPU capacity issue in ap-southeast3. Some requests may be slower or rerouted.\" Added link to incident channel.

eng-runtime-lead: We should also enable model-quantization for burst path (pg-quant) to reduce GPU memory per replica. Any objections?

platform-sre-anya: No objections. Deploying quantized variant to eu-west1 and us-east1 as fallback.

infra-oncall-kim: Quick note: check for preemptible quotas — we can request preemptible GPUs in ap-southeast3 as temporary relief if customers accept potential transient restarts. Would save ~20% latency but is risky for long-running sessions.

sales-eli: Only offer preemptible option to non-enterprise customers or explicitly opt-in. Enterprise customers need cross-region failover.

customer-ops: Logged acme-ai as routed to eu-west1 and notified them. They acknowledged: \"Thanks — please keep us posted.\"

incident-bot: Mid-incident summary (12m in): mitigations applied: route low-priority -> us-east1, reduce batch/concurrency, enterprise cross-region failover started, quantized fallback deployed. Quota request submitted. Monitoring queue and latency.

oncall-ryan: I’ll stay on until quota increase comes through or we show stable queues under threshold. Handing off to @infra-oncall-kim for overnight monitoring at 2912352000.

infra-oncall-kim: I’m taking over monitoring and will maintain the runbook checklist. If GCP approves quota, we can scale-up and drain fallback routes.

eng-runtime-lead: Please capture exact KB commands and config diffs for postmortem. I’ll start a draft.

platform-sre-anya: Saved diffs to runbook: /runbooks/incidents/ap-southeast3-gpu-exhaustion/changes-2912349999.md

support-jamie: Final note to log customer-impact tas: 12 customers with latency increase, 3 customers with transient 429s, 1 enterprise full throughput impacted until failover applied.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> partial. Pager resolved. Follow-up: postmortem and quota response.

infra-oncall-kim: Logged the handoff. I’ll push a second status update if anything changes.

support-jamie: Thanks everyone. I’ll coordinate postmortem notes with runtime and infra. :pray:

sales-eli: Thx team. Keeping execs looped.

customer-ops: acme-ai confirmed degraded metrics improved after reroute.

incident-bot: Thread closed to new pages at 2912354200.
